_documentation: Golden-region allowlist for the Section Builder v3.1 remediation (register §A M2).
Detection convention + comparison/exit-code semantics are documented in the header
comment of scripts/golden-allowlist.mjs, which reads this file. Do not hand-edit
startLine/endLine into this file — the script recomputes ranges from the live
source on every run; only 'id' (file::name), 'golden', 'register', and 'note' are
read from here. 'id' MUST equal '<file>::<declaration name>' or the script will
report the corresponding live block as UNCLASSIFIED.
Seeded 2026-07-13 (mission remediation/r0-foundation, phase R0 slice R0b) from a
live run of `node scripts/golden-allowlist.mjs` against the then-current source —
§C S4-A (LEGACY-NOT-IN-GOLDEN). Several S4-A rows describe cross-file regions
(templates/layout.ts, ui.ts) outside this gate's two scanned files, or a mix of
golden-legit and non-golden content inside one function; those approximations are
called out per-row below. The actual purge is phase R5 — this file is the R0
foundation seed, not a final classification.

Media picker — not flagged.
